base_eval_set: Warm fixed-test rows with at least 6 same-artist train-history rows

warm_lite_pooled_training.artist_cap_rule: training exposure k keeps at most k+1 rows per artist
warm_lite_pooled_training.group_stats: 5-fold internal stats on each capped exposure frame, then pooled
warm_lite_pooled_training.model: LightGBM Quantile full/lean + LightGBM objective=huber residual

limitations: Warm comparator is CF3 clean stack, not exact historical WMIN8/PPV8 full artifact rebuild.
Warm-lite k=5~6 remains outside the official Warm-lite route and is included as a stress comparison.
Pooled training intentionally augments repeated low-history exposure conditions, so it should be treated as a new candidate family.
